checks.description: The top 100 customer IDs must own at least 45% of orders so hotspot plans/contention are represented
checks.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) / (SELECT count(*) FROM sqlverify_demo.orders), 2) FROM sqlverify_demo.orders WHERE customer_id <= 100
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) / (SELECT count(*) FROM sqlverify_demo.orders), 2) FROM sqlverify_demo.orders WHERE status='pending'
